## Glossary (current definitions; cite the ID and version)
- plg:Vacant_v2 Vacant unit (from 2026-04-15) [excludes units under tender]: Lettable unit with no active or committed tenancy, excluding units under tender. Units under tender and units not lettable are reported separately. Historical figures are not restated.
- plg:UnderTender_v1 Under tender (from 2026-04-15): Vacant unit currently advertised in an open tender. Reported separately from vacant units.
- plg:NotLettable_v1 Not lettable (from 2026-04-15): Unit earmarked for upgrading or redevelopment; excluded from the occupancy denominator.
- plg:OccupancyRate_v1 Occupancy rate (from 2026-04-15): Tenanted units / (total units - not lettable units).
- plg:ActiveTenancy_v1 Active tenancy (from 2026-04-15): A tenancy with status Active whose start date <= reporting date <= end date. Pending Commencement tenancies are committed, not active.
- plg:CommittedTenancy_v1 Committed tenancy (from 2026-04-15): Tender awarded or offer accepted, not yet commenced (status Pending Commencement). The unit counts as tenanted for vacancy.
- plg:Arrears_v1 Arrears (from 2026-04-15): Unpaid invoice amounts (including GST) whose due date has passed. Late-payment interest is excluded unless stated.
- plg:DaysOverdue_v1 Days overdue (from 2024-03-01): Calendar days between the due date of the oldest unpaid invoice and the date of assessment.
- plg:MonthsOfArrears_v1 Months of arrears (from 2024-03-01): Total arrears divided by one month's rent inclusive of GST (monthly rent x 1.09).
- plg:ArrearsAgeingBucket_v1 Arrears ageing bucket (from 2026-04-15) [0-30, 31-60, 61-90, >90 days overdue]: Days-overdue bands used in the arrears ageing report.
- plg:LodTrigger_v2 Letter of Demand trigger (from 2026-04-01) [60 days overdue]: HEB Legal issues a Letter of Demand when any amount is 60 days overdue and no approved instalment plan is in force, after the mandatory hardship call between 31 and 45 days overdue.
- plg:ArrearsTerminationThreshold_v2 Arrears termination threshold (from 2026-04-01) [arrears > 3 x monthly rent x 1.09]: Arrears exceeding 3 months' rent (inclusive of GST) go to the Director, PLG with a recommendation on termination. Measured on the amount, not on the number of unpaid invoices.
- plg:DisplayArea_v2 Permitted display area beyond shopfront (from 2026-08-01) [1.0 m (NC units); 0.6 m (void-deck shops)]: NC units may display goods up to 1.0 m beyond the shopfront (pilot, max 50% of frontage), overriding POL-001 v3.0 cl. 7.3 for NC units. Void-deck shops stay at 0.6 m.
- plg:ConcentrationLimit_v1 Trade concentration limit (from 2025-07-01) [2 per NC (3 minimarts in NCs > 40 units)]: No more than 2 units in the same NC may operate the same trade; 3 for minimarts in NCs with more than 40 units.
- plg:MajorBreach_v1 Major breach (from 2026-04-15): Inspection outcome of unauthorised trade, unauthorised subletting, fire safety or structural defect (finding codes UNAUTH_TRADE, UNAUTH_SUBLET, FIRE_SAFETY, STRUCTURAL_DEFECT).
- plg:RenewalLeadTime_v1 Renewal application lead time (from 2025-01-15) [6 months before expiry]: Tenants must submit a complete renewal application at least 6 months before the tenancy expires.
- plg:LateRenewal_v1 Late renewal (from 2025-01-15): Renewal application submitted less than 6 months before the tenancy end date.
- plg:SecurityDeposit_v1 Security deposit (from 2025-01-15) [3 months' rent]: Three months' rent (exclusive of GST), payable before the tenancy or renewed tenancy starts.
- plg:SlaMet_v1 SLA met (i-EMS) (from 2026-04-15): An i-EMS ticket meets its SLA when completed date - created date <= SLA days. Misrouted tickets are excluded.
